profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm Eric Deiman, a Senior Software Engineer with experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, and SQL Server.

My core focus is building scalable, maintainable systems — from modernizing monoliths to deploying distributed microservices. I’ve led development efforts on high-traffic platforms, optimized backend performance through efficient SQL and service design, and consistently improved system reliability, response times, and uptime.

Tech Highlights:
• Full-stack development with .NET (MVC, Web API), JavaScript (ES6+, jQuery, Knockout.js, Backbone.js)
• Microservice architecture, API integrations, and backend optimization
• SQL Server: writing performant stored procedures, views, and T-SQL queries
• Agile, TDD, CI/CD practices, and mentoring developers in clean code and SDLC best practices

I thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments where clean architecture, testability, and long-term maintainability are priorities. I’ve also served as a mentor, code reviewer, and advocate for continuous learning within development teams.

Currently completing a B.S. in Computer Science at Western Governors University (expected 2026), expanding my formal foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.

Open to senior engineering roles where I can contribute immediately and continue growing alongside strong teams.

Let’s connect and talk tech!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the maintenance and enhancement of the flagship SMB tax form entry system, eFileMyForms.com, leveraging C# MVC, JavaScript, and SQL Server, resulting in a 22% increase in user satisfaction and 5% boost in conversions

• Optimized and scaled micro-services architecture, enhancing system reliability and responsiveness, contributing to improved user experience, reducing system latency by 20% and increasing uptime 99.99%

• Led the prototyping and modernization of the tax form entry system using jQuery and Materialize CSS, contributing to the platform's overall user interface improvements, which increased conversion of visitors to purchasers

• Migrated eFileMyForms code to Azure, including configuring CI/CD pipelines

• Created SQL tables, stored procedures, functions, and views to support microservices, improving data access performance by 15%

• Played an integral role in Agile processes, including sprint planning and code reviews, while mentoring new team members through onboarding and technical problem-solving

• Increased code quality through code reviews and writing unit, integration, and acceptance tests
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · C# · Agile Methodologies · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Microsoft SQL Server · SQL · JavaScript · Git · MVC 4 · Programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the development team in maintaining and enhancing the company’s flagship quoting and enrollment platform, Marketplace, utilizing C# MVC, Jquery, Bootstrap.js, and SQL Server, resulting in 10% faster quote generation and increased conversion

• Successfully implemented 10+ new insurance products, significantly expanding platform capabilities

• Developed and optimized micro-services to ensure high availability and performance across all features critical to Marketplace's operations and reducing API response time by 25%

• Facilitated transition to a new quoting platform while maintaining Marketplace as the enrollment solution, creating and realizing opportunities for specialization, flexibility, and efficiency of the components

• Provided ongoing mentorship and technical guidance to junior developers, helping them develop their problem-solving and coding skills in an Agile environment

• Increase code quality through code reviews and writing unit, integration, and acceptance tests

• Optimized, refactored, and reused code to improve performance and maintainability while ensuring maximum efficiency, effectiveness, and return on investment. Use design patterns and best practices for C# programming

• Created SQL tables, stored procedures, functions, and views to support microservices
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · C# · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · SQL · Git · Programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Bootstrap (Framework) · JavaScript · jQuery

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Individually maintained and enhanced the VB.NET-backed ASP.NET 2.0 websites for several Coldwell Banker metro areas, including Florida and Ohio

• Worked with clients from the different metro areas to identify and specify the various fixes and enhancements

• As part of a team, converted 14 metro website from .NET 2.0 to .NET 3.5, consolidating common functionality into reusable components

• Individually designed and implemented the upgrade of sites from Virtual Earth to Bing Maps 7

• Individually designed and implemented a C#-based application that allows testers to configure and run an email alert process as needed for testing

• Individually and as part of a team, continue to maintain and enhance the code for all 14 metro websites

positions.description:

• Maintained and enhanced the SQL Server back-end for the professional sports team management application

• Individually developed and enhanced e-commerce web sites for a variety of clients

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Individually converted a Visual Basic-backed .NET 1.1 web site to a C#-backed ASP.NET web application

• Replaced limited-functionality custom-developed web controls with the equivalent, full-featured ASP.NET 2.0 web controls

• Adapted the web application to use USBank's existing authentication infrastructure

• Finished the project ahead of time and on budget

• Project Manager at 3M Wireless Infrastructure
• Application Programmer at FNIS
• Application Programmer at US Bancorp/Piper Jaffray

positions.title: Application Programmer
positions.description:
• Worked as part of a rapid prototyping team to develop a web-based Quick Service Restaurant back office suite

• Individually developed several C# classes to integrate existing security infrastructure into the web-based suite

• Implemented several C#-backed ASP.NET 2.0 web pages for activities such as cash control and deposit tracking

• Wrote SQL Server stored procedures to isolate the web site from data representation

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
• Independently manage the upgrade and installation of wireless data collection equipment for warehouses and production facilities across the country

• Managed 15 installations in 18 months

• Responsibilities include:
    - Working with each individual facility to determine needs
    - Preparing drawings and standards for each installation
    - Working with vendors to set expectations and answer questions
    - Working with internal 3M network personnel to add and configure new equipment
    - Overseeing final system certification

• Manage the introduction of Wavelink's Avalanche, a product that allows for the remote management of wireless devices
Saved 3M an estimated $100,000 in the first year of operation

• Help troubleshoot and maintain wireless equipment

• Maintained, enhanced, and documented a Java application that translated VT220 codes to HTML tags on-the-fly over a TCP/IP connection, allowing legacy terminal-based data collection equipment to be used with new web-based applications
